# wallet scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:walletScheme`](gmeow-walletScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/walletScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The blockchain scheme of the wallet — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Monero, etc. Functional: a wallet operates on exactly one scheme (a multi-scheme container is several wallets).
